== Symbol crop ==
The standalone [[Reflections Gold Remastered]] symbol retains the gold disc and black rim from the [[:File:RG-GEMP-2-1B.png|card image]]. The surrounding white and silver card-frame ring has been removed to transparency. The retained colors and design are unchanged.
